steps.title: Keep the same actual process and phase operators

steps.title: Construct the canonical position lift and adjoint
steps.prose: The second factor gamma is a probability measure, hence fst pushes pi_y times gamma to pi_y. Its canonical L2 pullback B is a linear isometry. Set M=B*. The isometry gives B*B=I and norm(B)<=1; the Hilbert adjoint preserves operator norm. Tilted measures are zero or probability, so their finiteness and all product instances are obtained internally.
steps.evidence: Actual projection/pullback and adjoint norm/left-inverse calculations establish the claimed canonical B/M.

steps.title: Obtain Gaussian sections and their L1 mean
steps.formula: G\in L^2(\nu_y)\Rightarrow G\in L^1(\nu_y),\quad\bar G(x)=\int G(x,p)\,d\gamma(p)\in L^1(\pi_y).
steps.prose: For any raw G in L2(nu_y), finiteness implies G in L1. Signed product Fubini gives Gaussian-integrable sections almost everywhere and an L1 Gaussian mean gbar. Independently M[G] is an L2 class, hence has an L1 representative. Its equality with gbar has not yet been assumed.
steps.evidence: hprod, hbar1 and hMg establish the L1 basis without circularity. Gaussian section integrability follows from hprod and is returned explicitly in step5 at282.

steps.prose: Test against the L2 indicator i=1_s. Its canonical lift agrees with 1_s(x) almost everywhere. The integrand 1_s(x)G(x,p) is L1 by restriction of G to fst inverse(s). Adjoint duality and the L2 inner integral identify its product integral; signed Fubini gives the set integral of gbar. All changes of representatives are almost everywhere.
steps.evidence: Exact selected L1 restriction route proves H integrable before signed Fubini; all indicator and raw representative changes are AE.

steps.title: Recover the actual Gaussian L2 representative
steps.prose: The two L1 functions have identical integrals on all measurable finite-measure sets, so they agree almost everywhere. Transfer L2 membership from the existing class M[G] to the literal Gaussian mean and use Lp extensionality. This order avoids assuming the mean is L2 to prove it is L2.
steps.evidence: Existing heq transports L2 membership and Lp.ext yields the Gaussian quotient identity; sections are returned from hprod.prod_right_ae.

steps.title: Absorb the momentum flip
steps.prose: Transport the canonical lift representative through the measure-preserving reflection. Since fst(Rz)=fst(z), J B=B. The isometry and involution give J*=J by inner-product extensionality. Taking adjoints of J B=B gives M J=M.
steps.evidence: AE flip transport, isometry/involution and adjoint identity prove both absorption equations.

steps.prose: Define K_T=M A_T B. At zero time A_0=I and MB=I give K_0=I. Reverse composition under the adjoint, use B**=B and A_T*=J A_T J, and absorb both flips. Operator-norm composition and the three bounds1 prove contraction.
